title: Elliott-Halberstam Conditional Prime Gap Bound ≤ 12 (OQ-03-OQ-03)
description: Proves: under the Elliott-Halberstam conjecture (axiom maynard_tao_sieve_eh), the prime gap bound improves from 246 to 12 using k=5 admissible tuples {0,2,6,8,12}. 13 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms (1 imported from BoundedPrimeGaps.lean).

overview.historicalContext: Zhang (2013) proved bounded prime gaps unconditionally (≤ 70,000,000). Maynard-Tao reduced this to 246. Under the Elliott-Halberstam conjecture, the sieve works with k=5, giving gap ≤ 12.
overview.problemStatement: Prove: Elliott-Halberstam conjecture → prime gap bound ≤ 12 (using 5-element admissible tuple with diameter 12).
overview.proofStrategy: EH sieve requires only k ≥ 5. The 5-tuple {0,2,6,8,12} is admissible (passes all modular sieving constraints). Its diameter is 12. By EH sieve, primes have gaps ≤ 12 infinitely often.
keyInsights: **Admissible 5-tuple**: {0,2,6,8,12} is admissible — no reduced residue class mod p contains all 5 elements for any prime p. This is the minimal diameter admissible 5-tuple.
**EH threshold**: EH conjecture allows the sieve to work with k ≥ 5 rather than k ≥ 50 (unconditional). This is a massive saving.
**Quantitative improvement**: 12 < 246. The EH result uses 5 elements at distance 12 vs. 50 elements at distance 246 (Engelsma 2013).

sections.title: Elliott-Halberstam Sieve with 5-Tuple Admissibility
sections.summary: D(k) bounds: D(3)≤6, D(4)≤8, D(5)≤12. admissible_5_tuple: {0,2,6,8,12} admissible. prime_gap_le_12_EH: under EH, gap ≤ 12.

conclusion.summary: 13 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms (1 axiom imported: maynard_tao_sieve_eh). EH conditional prime gap bound ≤ 12 proved.
conclusion.implications: The EH conjecture is widely believed but unproved. This result shows the exact improvement in prime gap bounds that EH would give.
openQuestions: Can the Generalized Elliott-Halberstam conjecture give prime gap ≤ 6?
Can the admissible 5-tuple {0,2,6,8,12} be shown to be optimal (minimum diameter)?
Can the unconditional bound be improved below 246 using new sieve techniques?

mainTheorems.statement: EH → ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, primeGap n ≤ 12

mainTheorems.significance: Conditional improvement from 246 to 12 using only a 5-element admissible tuple
